name: GitHub Issue To PR
description: Turn an authorized GitHub issue into scoped implementation, validation, a linked PR, and a traceable handoff.
approval_boundaries: Require authority for issue mutation and PR creation.
Require separate merge authorization and passing checks.

phases.name: Issue context
phases.instructions: Read the issue, linkage, labels, constraints, and requested outcome.

phases.name: Repository context
phases.instructions: Map relevant source, commands, rules, and risks.

phases.name: Implementation plan
phases.instructions: Create small testable slices linked to acceptance criteria.

phases.name: Source check
phases.instructions: Confirm the implementation against authoritative source behavior.

phases.name: Implementation
phases.instructions: Implement the issue in small verified slices.

phases.name: PR preparation
phases.instructions: Run local validation and prepare the review package.

phases.name: Authorized PR creation
phases.instructions: Create or update the linked PR only with explicit authority.

phases.name: Required checks
phases.instructions: Inspect required checks and branch protection.

phases.name: Independent PR review
phases.instructions: Review PR metadata, issue traceability, findings, and checks.

phases.name: Issue-to-PR handoff
phases.instructions: Report issue, PR, validation, checks, risks, and next authorized action.
